case_name: Ramesh Gajendra Jadhav v Secretary, Late S. G. S. P. Mandal and others
respondent: Secretary, Late S. G. S. P. Mandal
holding: The appointment of the appellant, even if otherwise, in accordance with procedure would stand vitiated on this ground alone.

There was a collective error on the part of the University and College and more on the part of the University that led to this situation. But this mistake cannot vest indefeasible legal right in the appellant to be appointed or deemed to have been appointed against a reserve category while he is a candidate, admittedly, belonging to the open category and was so appointed by the Selection Committee.
